CREATE drop FUNCTION EDS.vw_BRANCH_DIM (@Datetoprocess DATE)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN



SELECT 
         SOL_ID
        ,BANK_ID
        ,DEL_FLG
        ,SOL_DESC
        ,AREA.SETID_SET_DESC AREA
        ,CASE WHEN SOL_ID = '5003' THEN 'METRO MANILA SOUTH REGION'
              WHEN SOL_ID = '5103' THEN 'METRO MANILA WEST REGION'
              ELSE REGION.SETID_SET_DESC
         END AS REGION
        ,EXTN_CNTR_CODE
        ,BANK_CODE
        ,ABBR_BANK_NAME
        ,BR_CODE
        ,ABBR_BR_NAME
        ,CLG_CENTRE_NUM
        ,MICR_CENTRE_FLG
        ,MICR_CENTRE_CODE
        ,MICR_BANK_CODE
        ,MICR_BRANCH_CODE
        ,ADDR_1
        ,ADDR_2
        ,CITY_CODE
        ,STATE_CODE
        ,PIN_CODE
        ,WKLY_OFF
        ,INSTRMNT_ENCODE_BATCH_NUM
        ,INSTRMNT_ENCODE_BLOCK_NUM
        ,STOP_CASH_FT_FLG
        ,STOP_CLG_FT_FLG
        ,STOP_XFER_FT_FLG
        ,USER_CASH_DR_LIM_EXCP_CODE
        ,USER_CLG_DR_LIM_EXCP_CODE
        ,USER_XFER_DR_LIM_EXCP_CODE
        ,TDS_CERT_NUM_CODE
        ,SAME_DAY_REV_TO_IBR_FLG
        ,DATE_OF_INSTALLATION
        ,DB_STAT_CODE
        ,DB_INT_STAT_CODE
        ,BOD_SYS_DATE
        ,LAST_SI_EXEC_DATE
        ,LCHG_USER_ID
        ,RCRE_USER_ID
        ,LCHG_TIME
        ,RCRE_TIME
        ,CUT_OVER_TIME
        ,VALUE_DATING_ON_HOLIDAYS
        ,TYPE_OF_CASH_ACCT
        ,BR_STAT_CODE
        ,HC_VAULT_LIMIT_IN_HC
        ,FC_VAULT_LIMIT_IN_HC
        ,CONSOL_VAULT_LIMIT_IN_HC
        ,SOL_ALIAS
        ,DB_STAT_USER_ID
        ,ATM_JOB_STATUS
        ,UNIFORM_BR_CODE
        ,LICENSE_NO
        ,BR_OPEN_DATE
        ,REGION_NAME
        ,DIVISION_NAME
        ,CIRCLE_OFFICE_NAME
        ,TDS_CIRCLE_NAME
        ,DP_CODE
        ,TAX_DEDN_DETAILS
        ,PAN_GIR_NO
        ,NUM_OF_TIMES_IBR_GEN
        ,OSP_MAX_OUT_STD_DAYS
        ,PROXY_PEND_VERIFN_EXCP_CODE
        ,PROXY_NOT_SQUARED_EXCP_CODE
        ,NEXT_CUST_NUM_CODE
        ,INSTRMNT_WISE_REG_ALWD
        ,HOME_CRNCY_CODE
        ,DDN_WARN_LEVEL
        ,DDN_WARN_LEVEL_EXCP_CODE
        ,EXTERNAL_SOL
        ,HIGH_VALUE_SOL
        ,PROFIT_CENTER
        ,ALL_EXT_TRANS_PROC_EXCP_CODE
        ,TR_ENABLE_FLG
        ,TR_HOME_CRNCY_CODE
        ,TS_CNT
        ,DESTRY_INVT_CLASS
        ,DESTRY_INVT_LOCATION
        ,EXT_EOD_NOT_COMP_EXCP_CODE
        ,CS_SOL_MESG1
        ,CS_SOL_MESG2
        ,FAB_FLG
        ,LOCAL_IMAGE_FLG
        ,RECEIVE_ALL_IMAGES_FLG
        ,SOL_PRIORITY
        ,PDC_INSTL_RUN_DATE
        ,SDL_ID
        ,BRANCH_IP_ADDRESS
        ,BRANCH_REF_PORT_NUM
        ,LAST_INT_CALC_DATE_FOR_SB
        ,SOL_EOD_STATUS
        ,MINOR_AGE
        ,CS_SOL_NATL_MESG1
        ,CS_SOL_NATL_MESG2
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_1
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_2
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_3
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_4
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_5
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_6
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_7
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_8
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_9
        ,BR_FREE_CODE_10
        ,REFERRAL_SET_ID
        ,CTS_ENABLED_FLG
        ,SOL_CLS_FLG
        ,SOL_CLS_DATE
        ,SOL_BOD_DATE
        ,PREF_LANG_CODE
        ,PREF_LANG_SOL_DESC
        ,MENU_DISABLE_FLG
        ,WKLY_OFF2
        ,TIME_ZONE
        ,SOL_NAT_FLG
        ,ALT1_SOL_DESC
        ,BATCH_OPER_DATE
        ,ENTITY_NAME
        ,ADDR_3
        ,CNTRY_CODE
        ,PARTITION_ALIAS
        ,REROUTE_STP_ALLOWED
        ,SOL_RESTARTABILITY_FLG
        ,MIN_AGE_OF_ACCT_OWNERSHIP_XFER
        ,MAX_AGE_OF_ACCT_OWNERSHIP_XFER
        ,RPT_TAX_YR_DDMM
        ,MRS_NAME
        ,TREA_FREE_TEXT1
        ,TREA_FREE_TEXT2
FROM EDS.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE SOL
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,SETID_SET_DESC FROM EDS.vw_AREA_DIM (@Datetoprocess)  WHERE SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG <> 'Y' )  AREA
        ON SOL.SOL_ID = AREA.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
        AND SOL.BANK_ID = AREA.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,SETID_SET_DESC FROM EDS.vw_REGION_DIM (@Datetoprocess)  WHERE SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG <> 'Y' )  REGION
        ON SOL.SOL_ID = REGION.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
        AND SOL.BANK_ID = REGION.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
WHERE @Datetoprocess BETWEEN SOL.SCD_Start_Date AND SOL.SCD_End_Date;



DECLARE @Datetoprocess DATE
SET @Datetoprocess = '2023-09-01';
SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM EDS.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE SOL
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,SETID_SET_DESC FROM EDS.vw_AREA_DIM (@Datetoprocess)  WHERE SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG <> 'Y' )  AREA
        ON SOL.SOL_ID = AREA.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
        AND SOL.BANK_ID = AREA.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,SETID_SET_DESC FROM EDS.vw_REGION_DIM (@Datetoprocess)  WHERE SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG <> 'Y' )  REGION
        ON SOL.SOL_ID = REGION.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
        AND SOL.BANK_ID = REGION.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
WHERE @Datetoprocess BETWEEN SOL.SCD_Start_Date AND SOL.SCD_End_Date;





CASE WHEN eds.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLESOL_ID = 5003 THEN 'METRO MANILA SOUTH REGION'
     WHEN eds.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLESOL_ID = 5103 THEN 'METRO MANILA WEST REGION'
     ELSE eds.REGION_DIM.SETID_SET_DESC
     END AS REGION

SELECT * FROM EDS.vw_BRANCH_DIM ('2023-09-01')

        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDS.vw_REGION_DIM ('2023-09-01') 
        UNION ALL

        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDS.vw_AREA_DIM ('2023-09-01')
